description: This file defines the Response class for a CreateConnection command within the connectivity commands of the Eclipse Ditto project. It encapsulates the response structure, JSON serialization/deserialization, and related metadata for handling create connection responses.

classes.name: CreateConnectionResponse
classes.description: Response class for the CreateConnection command, providing methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and encapsulating the connection data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new CreateConnectionResponse instance with the given connection and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a CreateConnectionResponse instance.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the Connection object encapsulated in the response.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Produces an Optional containing the JSON representation of the connection entity.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the connection JSON data into a JSON object builder according to the schema version.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the connection entity.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response object with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on connection data and superclass properties.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code considering the connection data.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the response object.
